plugin.description: Hold Shift over backpack equipment for 3 seconds to craft until target affixes match.
craftinghelper.instructions: Enable this feature, right-click a currency stack in your backpack, hover equipment, then hold Shift for 3 seconds. Release Shift to stop.
craftinghelper.independent_input: Other plugins keep their own input behavior. Disable conflicting automatic input while crafting.
craftinghelper.rule_hint: Enabled stop conditions use OR. Only affixes meeting the tier threshold qualify. Unknown results stop the session.
craftinghelper.rules_required: Select at least one available stop condition before running.
craftinghelper.no_source: Right-click a currency stack to record it
craftinghelper.status.idle: Hold Shift over equipment for 3 seconds.
craftinghelper.status.arming: Keep Shift held over the same equipment...
craftinghelper.status.preview: Preview ready; no clicks are sent.
craftinghelper.status.preview_ended: Preview changed; release Shift to restart.
craftinghelper.status.waiting: Waiting for new affixes and one currency consumption.
craftinghelper.status.matched: Target reached. Release Shift before restarting.
craftinghelper.status.frame_gap: Updates interrupted. Release Shift to restart.
craftinghelper.status.result_timeout: Result confirmation timed out; no retry sent.
craftinghelper.status.context_changed: Game or area changed; record currency again.
craftinghelper.status.game_unavailable: Game unavailable, inventory closed, or chat active.
craftinghelper.status.manual_input: Manual input detected; record currency again.
craftinghelper.status.settings_changed: Settings changed. Release Shift to restart.
craftinghelper.status.rules_missing: Configure a valid stop condition first.
craftinghelper.status.target_missing: Hover magic or rare equipment in your backpack.
craftinghelper.status.source_missing: Right-click a currency stack before holding Shift.
craftinghelper.status.source_changed: Currency source changed; record it again.
craftinghelper.status.input_rejected: Input checks failed; no click sent.
craftinghelper.status.data_changed: Affix data reloaded. Release Shift to restart.
